blurb: Boulder Pointe Golf Club features three 9-hole courses—Bluffs, Peaks, and Dunes—offering 18-hole combinations ranging from just over 5,000 to 7,000+ yards. The club is set on a reclaimed gravel mine with 15 lakes and scenic elevation changes. Amenities include a full-service clubhouse, banquet seating for 300, practice facilities, a pro shop, and a grill.
